title: A GUN SWAP NAMES THE KEY IT REALLY LANDS ON
why: Found by the review of 2026-10-07, in the v18.89 and v18.91 gun swaps: when the gun in his hands was also bound to a key of its own (key 8, say), dragging it onto the other gun on key 9 traded the two guns but said it went to slot 9, while the belt showed it on key 8 and left key 9 empty. The words now name the key the gun really shows on, in a raid and in the Undercroft.
now: Swapping guns on the belt says where the gun really went.
